criteria: Compare the stated issue, rule, material facts, outcomes, and any expressly stated exception. Treat a difference as a possible contradiction only if it remains unexplained by the supplied facts. Use no outside assumptions.

matching.precedent_a: A fictional panel found that a shop violated a quiet-hours rule by playing amplified music after 22:00. No exception applied.
matching.precedent_b: A fictional panel found a shop breached the same quiet-hours rule by playing amplified music after 22:00. The record states that no exception applied.

explained_outcome_difference.precedent_a: A fictional panel found routine street works after 22:00 violated the quiet-hours rule. No exception applied.
explained_outcome_difference.precedent_b: A fictional panel found street works after 22:00 did not violate the same quiet-hours rule because an express emergency water-main exception applied to an immediate repair.

unexplained_conflict.precedent_a: A fictional panel held that a permit allowed a temporary sign on a public walkway and that this placement complied with the stated walkway rule. No exception or different fact was identified.
unexplained_conflict.precedent_b: A fictional panel held that a permit allowed a temporary sign on the same type of public walkway and that this placement violated the same stated walkway rule. No exception or different fact was identified.

insufficient.precedent_a: A fictional decision discusses a permit, but the supplied excerpt does not state the issue, rule, facts, or outcome.
insufficient.precedent_b: A fictional decision discusses a permit. The supplied excerpt omits the relevant rule, facts, and outcome.
